newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Milano to manage cereals markets in DG VI.
newsitem.headline: Milano to manage cereals markets in DG VI.

text.p: Italian Franco Milano takes over responsibility for cereals and other markets as part of a reshuffle of senior agricultural posts.
Commission officials said that under the reorganisaton, approved by the Commission on Wednesday, Milano replaces Briton David Roberts as deputy director general responsible for markets.
Roberts moves across to manage international agricultural affairs and finances.
Spaniard Fernando Mansito Caballero remains deputy director general but will handle rural development, formerly run by Milano.
